key_insight: Thermal spray and PVD coatings are presented as key enabling technologies for decarbonizing aviation by improving component durability, efficiency, and service life while supporting net-zero goals.
engineering_relevance: For aerospace engineers and manufacturers, the roadmap highlights coating process innovation, AI-assisted optimization, and materials design as practical routes to reduce fuel use and extend maintenance intervals.
method: Expert summaries of current state, challenges, and R&D needs
Discussion of AI for process optimization, integration, and coating design
evidence_signal: The abstract is a qualitative roadmap synthesis rather than a new experimental dataset, so its main evidence comes from expert assessment and cross-cutting research direction mapping.
watch_item: Implementation will likely be constrained by qualification, scalability, and certification requirements in aerospace, where new coating systems must meet strict performance and safety standards.
paper_title: Innovative Coatings for a Greener Sky: The 2026 Strategic Roadmap for Thermal Spray and PVD Coatings
